empiricalActivityCandidates: ISIC A Agriculture, forestry and fishing
sectorBridge.mappingRisk: Model RESOURCE is a stylized upstream resource bundle, not one exact ISIC activity. Agriculture and mining have very different capital, labour and price structures.

empiricalActivityCandidates: selected ISIC C Manufacturing intermediate-goods activities
sectorBridge.mappingRisk: ISIC classifies producer activity, not whether output is intermediate material. Supply-use/product evidence is required to distinguish intermediate from final goods.

empiricalActivityCandidates: selected ISIC C machinery/equipment and capital-goods manufacturing
potential construction/investment-producing activities only if model semantics justify inclusion
sectorBridge.mappingRisk: Capital goods are defined by economic use, not by a single industry code. Industry-only mapping would mix intermediate and consumption products.

empiricalActivityCandidates: final-consumption producing activities identified through supply-use tables
sectorBridge.mappingRisk: Consumer goods/services are defined by final use. Retail/services cannot be silently equated with the model consumer sector.

liquidityEvidence.concept: cash reserves sufficient for operations without revenue
liquidityEvidence.observation: roughly half of small businesses entered the COVID-19 crisis with fewer than 15 days of cash reserves
liquidityEvidence.reason: Crisis-era small-business evidence is size- and episode-specific and does not identify a normal steady-state working-capital target.
